title: Game thread waiting on Render Thread (fence / flush)
fix_rationale: The trace shows the GameThread stalled waiting on a render command fence or rendering flush. The bottleneck lies in the RenderThread or GPU, which caused the GameThread to wait.
evidence_template: {timer} blocked the GameThread for {ms} ms ({share}% of excess time) waiting for the RenderThread to flush commands.

fixes.text: Avoid explicit FlushRenderingCommands() calls in gameplay C++ code or plugins.
Optimize RenderThread bottleneck (culling, visible primitives, draw calls) so fences clear faster.
Ensure multithreaded rendering is enabled and running without synchronous sync points.

verify: Re-capture the trace and confirm that FRenderCommandFence wait durations drop to normal baseline levels.
